assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished illustrated README cover for abap-graph, ultra-wide 3:1 landscape. Reference 1 is the approved Cheditte art direction: match its dark plum #231A28 background, cream #F4F0E8 bold sans-serif, lime #D4E86A connectors and clearly outlined isometric server, matte flat faces, sparse lavender grid on right. Reference 2 supplied SAP logo and reference 3 supplied Microsoft 365 logo are the authentic brand references. Do not invent marks. Left half: exact large heading 'abap-graph'; below it 'SAP and Microsoft 365'; bottom-left small 'Install only what you need'. Place the SAP and Microsoft 365 logos in a balanced small row beneath subtitle with generous transparent negative space, no backing badges or white boxes. Preserve blue SAP logo and four Microsoft colors; adapt Microsoft wordmark to cream for contrast. Right half: cream-front plum-side isometric application server with three distinct branching lime connections to independently floating dimensional envelope, folder holding a document, and calendar with a small meeting-link symbol. These are actual outlined illustrated objects not empty cards, no glossy 3D. Keep all copy legible and safely inset. No Teams logo, no other brand logos, no flower metaphor, no core terminology, no sales claims, no version number, no fake UI, no certification. Meaning: select individual Microsoft365 operations from SAP.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create an illustrated English documentation overview for abap-graph, landscape about 1600x1000. Use reference 1 for STRICT visual style: dark plum #231A28, cream typography and object fronts, lime connectors, lavender fine strokes, crisp outlined isometric objects with matte plum sides. References 2 and 3 are supplied authentic SAP and Microsoft365 logos. Small branding row top right directly on plum with no backing boxes; preserve logo colors, make Microsoft wordmark cream. Top left 'abap-graph', large heading 'Choose what you need'. Main area titled 'Microsoft Graph' contains six evenly spaced illustrated objects in 3 columns and 2 rows: envelope 'Mail'; calendar with join-link symbol 'Calendar'; folder with documents 'Files' and small 'SharePoint / OneDrive'; clipboard 'Lists'; 3 people 'Users & groups'; spreadsheet page 'Excel cells' with clear 'Experimental' and 'Requires Files; see support limits'. The six objects have breathing room with captions and subtle separate bases, not a pile of empty UI cards. Beneath main area separate slim full-width illustrated route: small SAP server → branching flow-node pictogram with label 'Workflows' → speech card with label 'Teams notifications'. This route must be visibly separate from the Microsoft Graph group and NOT connected to it. No Teams corporate logo (not supplied), use generic speech card. Footer exact 'Shared helper once. Add only the modules you need.' No implication that all modules must be installed. No fake test result, no version badge. Large readable text, all margins safe. Match sophisticated technical-publication style of approved reference, not glossy blue cloud marketing.

Use case: text-localization. Create the Turkish equivalent of this exact documentation illustration. Yalnız gereken modülleri ekleyin.' Keep abap-graph, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft365, SharePoint / OneDrive and Workflows unchanged. Adjust text size within captions for Turkish without clipping. No other changes.
